child_speech.description: Idiosyncratic child speech patterns - phonological approximations and semantic substitutions that cannot be memorized mappings. Sources: real children (Keshy, Luka) and documented child speech patterns from Sept 2025 article (post-training-cutoff).
child_speech.why_this_matters: Child speech requires genuine semantic understanding to decode. These are NOT typos, NOT common eggcorns, and NOT in training data. The Chinese Room cannot shuffle papers to get from 'emmatents' to 'elephants' - you have to KNOW what an elephant IS.
